stories.name: Salesforce stock valuation debate
stories.blurb: Investors and analysts are debating whether Salesforce shares are undervalued or a value trap after a prolonged decline and mixed earnings reactions.

stories.name: Salesforce Agentforce Expansion
stories.blurb: Salesforce is rolling out and securing its Agentforce AI agent platform across government, military, and enterprise customers through new models, partnerships, and deployments.

stories.name: Software Stocks Rally
stories.blurb: A broad rally in enterprise software and cloud stocks, including Salesforce, as investors rotate away from chipmakers and into software names amid AI optimism.

stories.name: Salesforce price target hikes
stories.blurb: A series of analyst notes in which multiple Wall Street firms raised their price targets on Salesforce while maintaining their ratings.

stories.name: ServiceNow AI Growth
stories.blurb: ServiceNow's stock performance and outlook are being driven by its fast-growing AI business and new AI alliances, even as shares remain down for the year.

stories.name: Snap Specs AI Partnerships
stories.blurb: Snap's Specs AI glasses gain enterprise tools from Nvidia, AWS, and Salesforce, boosting Snap's stock and fueling broader discussion of Nvidia's role in the AI boom.

rel.why: Salesforce is named as a partner in Snap's Specs AI glasses enterprise tools, directly linking it to the story.

past.name: Dow Jones Daily Movers
past.blurb: Recurring daily reports tracking Salesforce's stock performance among the top gainers and losers within the Dow Jones Industrial Average.

Salesforce surges 20% on Q2 beat, Anthropic deal

4.text: Salesforce shares have swung sharply, falling about 10-12% in 2026 after gaining 44-56% in the prior three months. Articles debate whether that drop makes CRM cheap, citing higher earnings estimates, AI disruption fears, and a $25 billion buyback.

5.text: Salesforce unveiled AIforce, an open AI layer, and reported rapid Agentforce adoption; it agreed to acquire Listen Labs and expanded Marketing Cloud governance via Stensul. Zenity Labs found three Agentforce vulnerabilities; Meta launched an enterprise AI platform competing with Salesforce.

7.text: Enterprise software stocks rallied midweek, with Salesforce, Atlassian, Monday.com and ServiceNow climbing about 3% even as broader tech fell and Treasury yields hit two-decade highs. Later, Meta's enterprise software launch triggered a sector selloff, dragging down ServiceNow, MongoDB and others.

9.text: Salesforce's Dreamforce customer survey supports its near-term growth outlook but shows little demand inflection, according to Oppenheimer. The survey results prompted Oppenheimer to maintain its view on the stock.

10.text: ServiceNow is integrating AI into its enterprise software and replacing legacy CRM and workflow tools, driving customer growth. The articles mention Salesforce only as the legacy CRM being displaced.

8.text: Snap unveiled SPECS Intelligence, an anticipatory AI service across iPhone, Mac, and SPECS AR glasses, plus enterprise deployments with partners. Salesforce is barely mentioned; the story bears on it only as a potential enterprise AR/AI partnership angle.
